# MEMMAL, a proof-of-concept for combined use of Machine Learning and SPARCED (Erdem 2023)

This page outlines the steps taken to replicate the results from
[_MEMMAL: A tool for expanding large-scale mechanistic models with machine learned associations and big datasets_](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/systems-biology/articles/10.3389/fsysb.2023.1099413/full)
by Cemal Erdem et al., published in 2023.
It includes details on the experimental setup, data preprocessing, code execution, and any deviations or clarifications needed to match the original findings.
